decision: Selected the planar centroid of the union of the three contiguous Hall County tax parcels that the TxGIO StratMap land-parcel layer lists as owned by LANCIUM TURKEY, LLC (Hall Appraisal District, tax year 2026), whose 471.1 legal acres match the approximately 465-acre campus QTS describes for its data center on Lancium's Clean Campus near Turkey, as the campus locator replacing the imported Turkey town point.
layer: TxGIO 'stratmap_land_parcels_48_most_recent' MapServer identify (layer 0), envelope -100.885,34.351,-100.847,34.368 (WGS84), returnGeometry true; the service does not support query, so identify over an envelope was used and the Lancium-owned rows were selected by owner name

facts.centroid_method: shapely centroid of the union in a local transverse Mercator (WGS84) at the union centroid, transformed back; the planar WGS84 centroid differs by 0.02 m
facts.excluded_lancium_parcel: Property 201525 (LANCIUM TURKEY, LLC, 300.43 legal acres) lies about 0.8 km east of the union and is not contiguous with it; with it the holding would total about 790 acres in two parts, well above the stated 465-acre campus, so it is excluded from the locator (its centroid lies 1,869 m from the selected point)

exclusions: Neighbouring parcels in the identify envelope belong to other owners, including private individuals; they are not part of the union and their owner names are not reproduced. No geocoder, map viewport, operator map widget, town centre or county centroid is used.
